Maya (Release Coordinator): Heads-up: rolling release train enters a 48h hold starting 2024-10-01 00:00 UTC. New owner-handoff checklist required for any post-hold hotfix. Put the checklist link in PR descriptions: https://intranet.redwood/handbook/release-handoff. Hotfixes allowed only for P0/P1 user-impacting issues.

Owen (Platform): Quick q: is a configuration-only change (feature flag flip) considered a hotfix?

Maya (Release Coordinator): If it's behind a feature flag AND reversible without DB/schema change, treat as hotfix-only if approved. Still need the form and on-call acknowledgement.

Priya (SRE): FYI our emergency rollback window is tightened during the hold. Auto-rollback will trigger on sustained 5xx > 1.5x baseline for 5 minutes. Add this to runbook snippet:

Priya (SRE): ```
# emergency rollback check
python infra/scripts/check_errors.py --window 5m --threshold 1.5
if triggered:
  ansible-playbook rollback.yml -e env=prod
```

notify-bot: Production canary report: canary-182 healthy, 5xx 0.12%, P95 170ms :white_check_mark:

Carlos (ML): We're planning a small tokenizer normalization tweak tomorrow. No model weight or schema changes. Filing hotfix form now. tagging @Maya @Priya

Maya (Release Coordinator): Thanks @Carlos. Please include a short smoke plan and the subset of prompts you'll run. I will roster approvers.

Owen (Platform): Also rolling out a small change to our deployment circuit-breaker thresholds. It's low-risk infra-only. Requesting fast-track approval.

Priya (SRE): For infra-only with no customer-visible change we can fast-track if both Platform lead + oncall ack in thread and form submitted. I'll mark SRE approval once the form shows.

Maya (Release Coordinator): Exec asked for a 1-line bullet for the weekly partner update. Please paste your area 1-liner by 18:00 PT.

Owen (Platform): 1-liner: improved deployment circuit-breaker defaults to reduce noisy rollbacks.

Carlos (ML): 1-liner: tokenizer normalization minor patch (no schema change).

Priya (SRE): 1-liner: tightened canary rollback automation and alerting thresholds.

Maya (Release Coordinator): 1-liner: release train 48h hold + new owner-handoff checklist; hotfix path for urgent regressions.

Owen (Platform): ack :thumbsup:

Maya (Release Coordinator): I'll post final approved hotfix list in this thread once approvals come in. If you think something might be borderline, submit early and tag me.
